name: otp-field
title: OTP field
description: A one-time code in one field frame (Base UI OTP Field): a cell per character on shared seams, groups split by a join cell, paste and SMS autofill, a Field participant; verification signals pending, done and failed in the frame.
whenToUse: Use it to enter a one-time code, one cell per character, with a checking state and an error. For other short text use Field.

parts.name: OtpField
parts.description: A one-time code in one field frame (Base UI OTP Field inside a Base UI Field), built from the parts above: every character is a cell on a shared seam, groups are split by a join cell, and the whole code is one Tab stop's worth of typing. A code reads left to right in every script, so the slots stay in that order in RTL; the ! cell and the message follow the page. A Form collects it by `name`; `validate`, `required` and the Form's `errors` reach it like any Field.

props.name: autoSubmit
props.description: Submit the owning form as soon as the code is complete.

props.name: groups
props.description: Split the slots into groups, e.g. [3, 3] for "123 456". Must add up to `length`; otherwise one group.

props.name: id
props.description: id of the first slot (Base UI derives `{id}-2`, `{id}-3`… for the rest).

props.name: inputMode
props.description: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its contents

props.name: label
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: Visible label (visually hidden with layout="cell"); it names the first slot, and the rest say "Character n of N".

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own 2px frame. cell: a cell of an enclosing frame (label visually hidden).

props.name: name
props.description: Form name; the submitted value is the code (possibly incomplete).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the code and Base UI's event details (the reason, the event).

props.name: onValueComplete
props.description: Fired once every slot holds a character (and when a complete code is pasted again). Verify here.

props.name: signal
props.description: The verification of a complete code, shown in the frame (Button's signals): pending: a segment runs along the bottom keyline and the slots are read-only (aria-busy); done: a ✓ cell is inserted at the end; failed: the frame turns red, the ! cell is inserted at the start and, if focus was in the field, the caret returns to the first slot with the code still visible. Pair failed with `error` ("That code has expired. Send a new one.").

props.name: signalText
props.type: { pending?: string | undefined; done?: string | undefined; }
props.description: Announced politely while pending and when done. Default "Checking the code…" and "Code verified."

props.name: slotLabel
props.description: Accessible name of slot n (from 2). Default (n, total) => `Character ${n} of ${total}`.

props.name: validationType
props.description: numeric (default) · alpha · alphanumeric (recovery and invite codes) · none.

parts.name: OtpFieldFrame
parts.description: The field frame: the attention cell (inserted at its start, open while the field is invalid), then its children (the OtpFieldRoot, and any signal cells). `units` is the code's width in slots (a join counts half), which sizes every slot. `layout="cell"`: the frame is a cell of an enclosing frame and the code takes the cell's width.

parts.name: OtpFieldInput
parts.description: One character's cell. Base UI derives each slot's id from the root's `id` (`{id}-2`, `{id}-3`…).

parts.name: OtpFieldRoot
parts.description: Base UI's OTPField.Root: the row of slots, always left to right. Typing advances, Backspace goes back, arrows move, paste and SMS autofill (`one-time-code`) fill every slot. `onValueChange` gets Base UI's event details last.

parts.name: OtpFieldSeparator
parts.description: The join between groups: a drawn dash in its own narrow cell, no seam of its own (the slot after it draws one).
